title: Private Upgrader: Migration Telemetry, Preflight Safety Net, and Staged Rollback
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an extensible 'Private Upgrader' component for Redwood Private that coordinates schema/config migrations and provides a baked-in safety net (preflight checks, staged rollback, and automated telemetry) for VPC/on-prem customers. The goal is to allow operators to perform minor and major upgrades with minimal downtime, clear visibility into migration progress, and automatic quarantine/rollback on predefined failure modes. This is focused on three areas: (1) migration orchestration primitives (transactional migration runner, idempotent hooks, stall detection), (2) a preflight and gating layer that validates clusters before applying migrations (checksums, disk/CPU thresholds, compatibility matrix against LTS channels), and (3) telemetry and alerting for migration health and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: A preflight step can be executed against a target Private cluster and returns a pass/fail with actionable errors (node health, disk, K8s version compatibility, schema diffs).
The migration runner supports pause/resume and records deterministic checkpoints to allow safe resume after failure without manual intervention.
An operator-facing migration progress stream (events & counts) is emitted to the Console and to customer logging via webhook/Kafka for each migration step.
Automated rollback can be triggered by an operator or by a policy when one of the high-severity checks fails (e.g., >5% request error increase, prolonged leader election).
Runbook and Confluence doc updated with preflight checklist, troubleshooting, and rollback step-by-step for LTS-to-LTS upgrades.

E2E test harness that runs staged upgrade in CI against a small K8s cluster (E2E infra: Jordan) - create GH workflow
Security review and KMS integration for migration secrets (Security: Hannah)
rollout_plan: Alpha: run on internal staging customers with feature flag enabled (2-week window).
Canary: select 3 private customers (PS-led) for guided upgrade; collect telemetry and runbook feedback (4 weeks).
Gradual rollout: enable automated preflight gating by default for all Private upgrades; keep manual override for 30 days.
LTS channel consideration: ensure backward-compatible schema migrator runs for LTS-1 -> LTS and has explicit operator confirmation for incompatible migrations.
rollback_plan: Soft rollback: stop migration and resume previous process using checkpointed snapshot (zero schema-change rollback where possible).
Hard rollback: run compensating migrations or restore from cluster backup (automated snapshot restore playbook).
Emergency abort: advertise read-only mode and route traffic to standby region; notify oncall and open incident bridge.
telemetry_spec: MigrationStart / MigrationStepStart / MigrationStepComplete events (tags: cluster_id, upgrade_channel, sequence_id)
Health signals to surface: leader_elections, tail_latency_99p, pod_restart_rate, disk_utilization
testing_plan: Unit tests for migration runner state transitions and idempotency (CI coverage goal: 90%).
Integration: run staged upgrade across 3 K8s versions and 2 LTS channels in CI lab (use KinD cluster matrix).
Chaos window: inject pod restarts and network partitions during a blue-green migration to validate rollback triggers.
Customer beta: coordinated test with 3 customers in the Canary cohort, run with PS and SRE onboarded.
